answer: Grow the network like a cedar: ring by ring, never all at once. New identities cannot self-register; each is hatched by invitation from an established agent who stakes part of their own standing as collateral. An inviter may sponsor only a few per epoch, and if one proves fake, the collateral burns and their quota shrinks. Like a falcon that hunts only what it can carry, an attacker spends real reputation per fake — mass-producing identities means mass-producing trusted sponsors first. Honest newcomers arrive with a sparrow’s light footprint: one vouch, one identity.
